final_response_fingerprint.details: READ-ONLY independent review. Do not edit repo files, do not run git commands that modify state, do not run cargo. Repo ~/.jcode (uncommitted working tree; other workers have unrelated edits in background*, ambient*, overnight*; ignore them). Review openspec change `add-lifecycle-hooks` (openspec/changes/add-lifecycle-hooks/{proposal,design,tasks,specs}) against the implementation: crates/jcode-base/src/hooks.rs, hooks_lifecycle.rs, hooks_lifecycle_tests.rs (untracked), crates/jcode-config-types/src/lib.rs, crates/jcode-app-core/src/lifecycle_hooks.rs (untracked), docs/HOOKS.md, and the lifecycle hook wiring hunks in crates/jcode-app-core (turn_execution*, agent/*, lib.rs, tool dispatch, swarm completion, compaction) found via `git diff` and grep for lifecycle_hooks. Check each spec scenario has an implementation and a test that fails without it. Pay special attention to: backward compat of legacy [hooks] keys/env overrides and no duplicate dispatch; PreToolUse deny/ask/fail_closed on timeout/crash/bad JSON; exit code 2; Stop continuation bounded and obeys durable admission/user cancel/budgets (explicit cancel NEVER admits another turn); recursion guard; hook child process timeout kill and settlement tracking; output bound and secret redaction; config matcher/glob validation not aborting startup; interaction with existing hook_policy_denial and config-composition (project-local config must not be able to enable dangerous hooks from untrusted sources? check how project config trust is handled and flag if hooks from a project-local config would execute commands without the global opt-in); and that checked tasks.md boxes have real evidence. Write findings to ~/.jcode/scratch/applyall/review-lifecycle-hooks.md with severity (blocker/major/minor), file:line, fix suggestion; end with APPROVE or CHANGES REQUESTED. Reply only 'done' plus verdict.
